name: Nippon Prologis REIT, Inc.
summary: Nippon Prologis REIT, Inc. was listed on the REIT Securities Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on February 14, 2013. NPR has strategically focused on investment for Class-A logistics facilities from its inception backed by the Prologis Group's strong sponsor support and has aimed to maximize unit holders' value by maintaining a portfolio that generates stable income. As a result of such investment management, NPR owned 61 properties for 960,217 million yen, all of which are Class-A logistics facilities developed by the Prologis Group, as of May 31, 2025. Nippon Prologis REIT, Inc. was established on Nov 7, 2012.
